book.title: Jim's Halloween Maze Adventure
book.subtitle: 50 Candy Collecting Mazes for Kids Ages 6 to 10

scenes.title: The Attic Hunt
scenes.text: Jim's costume box is somewhere up in the attic. Find a way through before the sun goes down.

scenes.title: The Stuck Zipper
scenes.text: The ghost suit is inside out and the zipper will not move. Get across the bedroom to the sewing box.

scenes.title: Mirror Practice
scenes.text: Jim paints a white swirl on each cheek. Help him step past the toys and books to reach the tall mirror.

scenes.title: Soup Before Sweets
scenes.text: Mom says soup before sweets. Find a way through the busy kitchen so Jim can reach his warm bowl.

scenes.title: The Missing Flashlight
scenes.text: The flashlight rolled under the couch again. Help Jim wiggle past the pillows and boots to grab it.

scenes.title: The Candy Bucket
scenes.text: The pumpkin bucket sits high on the closet shelf. Find a clear path so Jim can lift it down.

scenes.title: Boots By The Door
scenes.text: One boot waits by the door and one hides under the stairs. Help Jim hop through the hall to find both.

scenes.title: The Front Door
scenes.text: The porch light is on and the night smells like wet leaves. Find a way past the coats to the front door.

scenes.title: Down The Garden Path
scenes.text: Damp leaves cover the stepping stones in the yard. Help Jim follow the path down to the little apple tree.

scenes.title: The Squeaky Gate
scenes.text: The gate squeaks in the wind at the end of the yard. Find a way around the flower pots to open it.

scenes.title: The First Porch
scenes.text: The first house has a grinning pumpkin by the steps. Help Jim reach the doorbell and say trick or treat.

scenes.title: The Barking Dog
scenes.text: A small dog barks behind the fence and wags his tail. Find a quiet way past him to the next driveway.

scenes.title: The Sprinkler Surprise
scenes.text: A sprinkler spins on the wet grass. Help Jim zigzag across the lawn and keep his ghost sheet dry.

scenes.title: Between The Hedges
scenes.text: Tall hedges line the sidewalk like green walls. Find a way through the gaps so Jim can keep going.

scenes.title: Sheets On The Line
scenes.text: White sheets flap on the line like floating ghosts. Help Jim slip between them to the back gate.

scenes.title: The Corner Store
scenes.text: The corner store window glows with orange lights. Find a path down the busy aisle to the candy counter.

scenes.title: The Pile Of Leaves
scenes.text: A giant pile of leaves blocks the sidewalk. Help Jim crunch a trail through it without dropping his bucket.

scenes.title: A Crowd Of Pirates
scenes.text: Pirates and robots fill the sidewalk with laughing and shouting. Find a way through the crowd to the next porch.

scenes.title: The Spider Mailbox
scenes.text: A rubber spider dangles from the neighbor's mailbox. Help Jim duck under it and get to the porch light.

scenes.title: The Long Driveway
scenes.text: The last house on the street sits far back from the road. Find a way up the long driveway to the door.

scenes.title: Into The Park
scenes.text: The park gate stands open and the sky turns purple. Help Jim find a path through the dark trees.

scenes.title: The Duck Pond
scenes.text: Ducks bob on the still water under the first stars. Find a dry path around the pond to the stone bridge.

scenes.title: The Pumpkin Patch
scenes.text: Fat pumpkins sit in muddy rows across the field. Find a way between them to the wagon at the far side.

scenes.title: The Hay Bale Maze
scenes.text: Hay bales make walls taller than Jim. Find the way through them to the lantern glowing in the middle.

scenes.title: The Quiet School Yard
scenes.text: The school yard is quiet and the swings sway in the breeze. Help Jim cross the blacktop to the open gate.

scenes.title: The Skeleton Band
scenes.text: A skeleton band plays kazoos on the bandstand. Help Jim hop through the folding chairs to hear the song.

scenes.title: The Bat Alley
scenes.text: Bats swoop over the alley lights, squeaking hello. Find a path between the trash cans to the bright street.

scenes.title: The Fountain Square
scenes.text: Water splashes in the old stone fountain. Help Jim weave through the benches to the candy stand.

scenes.title: The Costume Parade
scenes.text: Drums thump as the costume parade fills the street. Find a way through the marchers to the sidewalk.

scenes.title: The Library Steps
scenes.text: Paper bats hang above the library steps. Help Jim climb through the crowd to the treat bowl by the door.

scenes.title: The Old Orchard
scenes.text: Twisted apple trees lean over the tall grass. Help Jim find a path between the trunks to the stone wall.

scenes.title: The Cobweb Shed
scenes.text: Silver webs cover the door of the little garden shed. Help Jim brush past them to the lantern inside.

scenes.title: The Foggy Lane
scenes.text: Thick fog rolls along the narrow lane. Help Jim follow the fence posts until the streetlight glows again.

scenes.title: The Black Cat
scenes.text: A black cat sits in the middle of the lane and purrs. Find a way around her so Jim can keep walking.

scenes.title: The Graveyard Fence
scenes.text: Old stones stand in rows behind the iron fence. Help Jim follow the fence line to the gate at the corner.

scenes.title: The Creaky Bridge
scenes.text: The wooden bridge creaks over a chuckling stream. Find the dry boards that lead Jim to the other side.

scenes.title: The Whispering Willow
scenes.text: A willow brushes the path with long green fingers. Help Jim slip under the branches and back to the road.

scenes.title: The Lighthouse Path
scenes.text: The lighthouse beam sweeps over the rocks. Find a path up the steep steps to the keeper's candy dish.

scenes.title: The Dancing Skeletons
scenes.text: Skeletons clack and tap dance in the old barn. Help Jim spin through the hay to the fiddle player.

scenes.title: The Owl Loft
scenes.text: A round owl blinks down from the hay loft. Find a way past the buckets and ropes to the open door.

scenes.title: The Mansion Gates
scenes.text: Tall iron gates stand at the top of the hill. Help Jim find the open one and start up the winding drive.

scenes.title: The Hedge Maze
scenes.text: Green walls twist and turn in the mansion garden. Find the path to the stone bench at the center.

scenes.title: The Grand Porch
scenes.text: Cobwebs hang like lace across the huge front porch. Help Jim duck under them to reach the brass bell.

scenes.title: The Great Hall
scenes.text: Candles flicker in the great hall and a ghost waltzes by. Find a way across the checkered floor.

scenes.title: The Cellar Steps
scenes.text: Jars of pickles line the cool cellar walls. Help Jim find a path through the crates to the light switch.

scenes.title: The Tower Stairs
scenes.text: Stone stairs curl up and up inside the tower. Help Jim climb past the flapping bats to the very top.

scenes.title: The Dusty Ballroom
scenes.text: A music box plays in the dusty ballroom. Find a way between the covered chairs to the tall glass doors.

scenes.title: The Mansion Attic
scenes.text: Trunks and old hats fill the mansion attic. Help Jim tiptoe through the boxes to the round window.

scenes.title: The Last Big House
scenes.text: Paper ghosts float above the last big porch on the hill. Help Jim reach the door for the final treats.

scenes.title: Home At Last
scenes.text: Jim's own porch light glows warm and yellow. Help him reach the steps, then dump out the bucket and count the candy.
